role: Real, standard likelihood x impact risk matrix — genuine deterministic scoring banded into low/medium/high/critical, verified against real cases including the exact boundary before implementation.
behaviorDescription: assessRisks() computes score = likelihood x impact for each real item and bands it (critical >= 20, high >= 12, medium >= 6, low otherwise). Surfaces the real highest-scoring risk and a real critical count. No LLM needed — fully deterministic.
hardStops: Never fabricates a likelihood or impact value — always computed from real input data
Never suppresses a critical finding — a genuine score of 20+ is always reported as critical
